title: Calibrate all one-species classes and independent products in polynomial binary time
statement: For fixed one-species weakly reversible R, if no nontrivial rule is enabled the class is a singleton: feasibility forces m=x0 and lambda=1. Otherwise an enabled positive increment can be repeated (a negative step has a weak-reversible return path containing such an increment), so the actual class is unbounded. Its minimum a<T_R, largest source stoichiometry, is found by a fixed finite number of paid membership tests. With Delta=max|z-y|, enabled-rule connectivity gives Gamma intersect[t,t+Delta] nonempty for every integer t>=a. At lambda_lo=epsilon/8, 0<=E X-a<=lambda*exp(lambda)<=epsilon/4; if m<=a+epsilon/2 return it. Otherwise take t=ceil(m)+1 and s inGamma intersect[t,t+Delta]. At lambda_hi=4(ceil(m)+Delta+2), weight(x)/weight(s)<=4^-(s-x) for x<s, hence E X>=s-sum_(k>=1)k4^-k=s-4/9>m. Both endpoints have O_R(L) bits. A uniform polynomial-bit U on the interval gives mu-prime(lambda)=Var(X)/lambda<=(U^2+1)/lambda_lo=:H with log H=O_R(L). Certified rational bisection uses moment accuracy epsilon/32; accept estimated mean distance<=epsilon/2, otherwise retain the correct side. Cap at width epsilon/(4H), O_R(L) iterations, then return midpoint. Error is<=epsilon and ordinary numerator/denominator heights, work, RAM and compiler cost are bounded by emitted computable C_R(1+L)^p_R. Cartesian products of independent one-species systems factor actual classes and factorial laws, so coordinate calibration gives the same complete positive subclass for fixed d. This does not solve coupled multispecies R.

assumptions: The full uniform polynomial-complete-binary inverse for arbitrary COUPLED multispecies R and a fixed-R negative both remain OPEN. General existence/termination are weaker than efficient parameter-height/selection. The FULL one-species theorem and independent-species product subclass are complete positives at their literal scopes. The efficient moment oracle substantially overlaps the accepted Root U1781 same-class secant interface and is credited ONCE; the complete P3 derivation is nevertheless source-linked here. Standard exponential-family existence, finite-support maximum entropy and affine-stratification results are not new generic efficient inverse solvers. Native history was rate limited: the full DISPLAYED response uses TeX from visible math annotations and may omit source-button labels; no raw-native identity claim, no ZIP visible or recovery. Source author calls these conversational derivations, not independent peer review; no external-review gate is imposed. Every known/unknown source/access/transfer hold remains.
costs: At specified rational activities the SAME-class mean evaluator pays polynomial bits in(R,lambda,x0,delta), including very rare conditioning: choose polynomial-bit U with E X_i^2<=U^2+1, h=delta/[16(U+2)^2], and value precision delta*h/16. General rational enumeration TERMINATES but has no proved polynomial global worst-case bound. For fixed one-species R, a<T_R and increments bounded by Delta give O_R(L)-bit activity brackets, O_R(L) bisections and ordinary positive rational output of polynomial binary length. All finite compiler/class tables/moment calls are paid in computable C_R,p_R. No sampler, optimizer, moment evaluator or reaction program is executed by Capital.
contract.units: Complete binary BIT work/memory/ordinary rational activity output; entire-law sup-coordinate mean accuracy.
obstruction: Establish both a uniform polynomial ordinary-rational activity-height bound and an efficient global selector for arbitrary coupled fixed R, or a justified fixed-R obstruction. General existence, enumeration and the full one-species theorem do not complete that target.
